title: Verbalising Model's Computation for Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.23275v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current Chain-of-Thought (CoT) verification methods detect reasoning faithfulness from model outputs or static activations, but are limited in explaining how unfaithfulness develops during generation. We introduce VERITAS to verbalise the model's computation: how different reasoning anchors emerge, transfer across layers, and surface in the output. VERITAS adopts the layer-wise Jacobian projection to produce a verbalised account of the model's internal reasoning evolution at each generated CoT token. By training a classifier on the extracted features along the traces, we show that these structured features provide insightful perspectives on how and where reasoning diverges toward unfaithfulness. Experiments on four datasets from FaithCoT-Bench and BonaFide show that VERITAS achieves a significant performance gain over LLM-as-Judge, with a 28.4% gain in balanced accuracy, and an average improvement of 16.0% over activation probing. Furthe

translated_title: 将模型计算过程言语化以用于思维链忠实性检测
translated_abstract: 当前的思维链（CoT）验证方法从模型输出或静态激活中检测推理忠实性，但在解释不忠实性在生成过程中如何发展方面存在局限。我们提出VERITAS来将模型的计算过程言语化：即不同的推理锚点如何产生、如何跨层传递以及如何在输出中显现。VERITAS采用逐层雅可比投影（layer-wise Jacobian projection），在生成的每个CoT token处产生模型内部推理演化的言语化描述。通过沿推理轨迹提取的特征训练分类器，我们证明了这些结构化特征能够深刻揭示推理如何以及在何处偏离至不忠实状态。在来自FaithCoT-Bench和BonaFide的四个数据集上的实验表明，VERITAS相比LLM-as-Judge取得了显著的性能提升，平衡准确率提高了28.4%，相比激活探测（activation probing）方法平均提升了16.0%。
tldr: VERITAS通过逐层雅可比投影将模型内部计算过程言语化，追踪推理锚点在各层间的产生、传递与显现过程，从而揭示推理偏离不忠实状态的机制，在思维链忠实性检测上显著超越LLM-as-Judge（平衡准确率提升28.4%）和激活探测方法（平均提升16.0%）。
en_tdlr: VERITAS verbalises a model's internal computation via layer-wise Jacobian projection to trace how reasoning anchors emerge, transfer across layers, and surface in outputs, achieving significant improvements in chain-of-thought faithfulness detection with a 28.4% balanced accuracy gain over LLM-as-Judge and 16.0% average improvement over activation probing.
